# waldur_marketplace_resource_api_keys (Data Source)

List of Marketplace Resource Api Key matching the filters

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The access keys the site agent has issued for a resource
data "waldur_marketplace_resource_api_keys" "s3" {
  filters = {
    resource_uuid = waldur_marketplace_order.s3.marketplace_resource_uuid
    state         = "OK"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes) Filter parameters for querying Marketplace Resource Api Key (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) Marketplace Resource Api Key objects matching the filters, in the order the API returns them (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Optional:

- `customer_uuid` (String) Consumer organization UUID
- `has_pending_action` (Boolean) Has a pending command
- `modified_before` (String) Modified before
- `offering_uuid` (String) Offering UUID
- `paused_by_limit` (Boolean) Paused by a spending limit
- `pending_action` (String) Pending command
- `project_uuid` (String) Project UUID
- `provider_uuid` (String) Keys of resources of the offerings of this service provider organization, to callers the provider resource list shows those resources to.
- `resource_uuid` (String) Resource UUID
- `state` (String) API key state
- `user_uuid` (String) Assignee UUID


<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `allowed_models` (List of String) The key's own model list, as chosen.
- `client_id` (String) Client Id
- `description` (String) Description
- `effective_models` (List of String) The models the key can call: the resource's selection, then the key's list. The site agent applies this one.
- `error_message` (String) Error Message
- `estimated_cost` (String) What the key's usage this month costs at the unit prices of the resource's plan, without discounts or credits. Zero until the first usage report of the month; recomputed on every report.
- `id` (String) Marketplace Resource Api Key UUID
- `issued_at` (String) When the agent last stored a value for this key: its creation or its latest rotation. Unlike modified, a pause or an edit leaves it alone.
- `limit_resumes_at` (String) When every limit that paused the key has reset, so that it resumes without a new usage report. Empty while a reached total limit holds the key: a total never resets, so the key resumes only when that limit is raised or cleared.
- `limits` (Map of Number) The month limits of spending_limits, per component type, for clients that know only monthly limits.
- `offering_uuid` (String) Offering Uuid
- `paused_by_limit` (Boolean) Waldur paused the key because its usage reached a limit. Such a key is resumed automatically once its usage is under its limits again: when the period of the limit resets, or when a limit is raised. A total limit never resets, so only raising or clearing it does.
- `pending_action` (String) Pending Action
- `resource_backend_id` (String) Resource Backend Id
- `resource_name` (String) Resource Name
- `resource_plan_uuid` (String) Resource Plan Uuid
- `resource_spending_limits` (Map of String) The resource's spending limits, per component and period, which cap every key of the resource.
- `resource_uuid` (String) Resource Uuid
- `spending_limit_status` (Attributes List) Spending Limit Status (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--spending_limit_status))
- `spending_limits` (Map of String) Limits per component type and period.
- `state` (String) State
- `usage_period` (String) Usage Period
- `user_full_name` (String) User Full Name
- `user_uuid` (String) User Uuid

<a id="nestedatt--items--spending_limit_status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.spending_limit_status`

Read-Only:

- `component_type` (String) Component Type
- `limit` (Number) Limit
- `period` (String) Period
- `reached` (Boolean) Reached
- `resets_at` (String) When the current period ends and its usage starts from zero. Null for total, which never resets.
- `used` (Number) Usage reported in the current period.
